'''June 2000 Tempe tournament (11 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Arizona Gamer, Tempe, Arizona on 11 June 2000. [[Michael Girard]] won it. It is known from Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d884">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-12-out-of-hibernationd884/ out-of-hibernation], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 12 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-12-out-of-hibernationd884/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 June 2000
* '''Site:''' Arizona Gamer, Tempe, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Girard]]
